subject: Invoice INV-4432 — collection window variance and payment path
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: AP Team <ap@solstice.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice INV-4432 — collection window variance and payment path

Hi AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-4432 (due 2026-12-07) — we saw the card attempt declined earlier this week. Can you confirm whether Solstice will send ACH or wire for this payment?

Quick notes:
- If you choose ACH, standard settlement is 3–5 business days.
- If you choose wire, funds typically land same/next business day but AP may need our bank proof (attached) for reconciliation.
- We understand there may be VAT withholding on your side; please confirm percentage and PO number so we can map correctly.

Attachments: INV-4432.pdf (invoice)

If ACH is easier, we can keep PO mapping and mark the invoice matched on receipt. If wire is preferred, please send remittance to ap@redwood.com with the transaction reference.

I can also offer a short early-payment incentive if you can commit to payment by 2026-12-16 — happy to outline. Please let me know the path and ETA.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@solstice.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@solstice.com>, Toby Li <toby.li@solstice.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4432 — collection window variance and payment path

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the note. Our card provider flagged the transaction and AP did not capture the charge. We can pay but need a confirmed PO number on the invoice before we process. Our AP workflow will withhold 5% VAT at source per our local tax counsel — that will need to be reflected on the remittance advice.

Options for us:
- ACH: preferred for lower fees, will take 3–4 business days once PO is added and bank details are validated.
- Wire: we can push same-day domestic wire but we require bank proof and beneficiary name to match invoice.

Can you attach bank proof and an updated invoice with PO 98721? Also confirm if you can accept partial payment (net of VAT withholding) and issue a withholding certificate for reconciliation.

Best,
Emily Ross
CFO, Solstice Therapeutics
emily.ross@solstice.com

Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4432 — collection window variance and payment path

Hi Emily / AP team,

Thanks — attaching bank proof and an updated invoice with PO 98721 as requested. Attachments: redwood_bank_proof.pdf, payment_instructions_v2.pdf, INV-4432.pdf (updated).

Clarifications:
- We can accept partial remittance net of VAT withholding. When you remit the net amount, please send the withholding certificate / remittance advice to ap@redwood.com and we will apply the credit to INV-4432.
- If you choose wire, please include the invoice ID in the beneficiary reference. We will temporarily waive the standard same-day wire processing fee for this payment if Solstice sends funds by 2026-12-16.
- Alternatively, offer: 1% early-pay credit if full net payment posts by 2026-12-16 (applied as account credit).

If ACH is preferable, we recommend ACH for cost reasons; expect 3 business days once our bank details are validated. Please confirm which path and an estimated payment date so we can reconcile on receipt.

I have looped in Neha from Collections and Laura from Finance to support VAT reconciliation.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: recommended routing and concession for Solstice INV-4432

Internal note — do not include external recipients.

Irene / Ben / Laura,

Recommend we:
1) Offer the 1% early-pay credit (keeps the customer happy and accelerates cash).
2) Prefer ACH as default; however, approve same-day wire if Solstice pushes that route — we've waived the wire fee for this request.
3) Once AP sends remittance, require the withholding certificate before we apply the VAT credit on our side. If Solstice sends a partial net payment, we'll post as "partial paid" and follow up for certificate.

I'll take point on reconciliation once funds are received. Ben — can you nudge the commercial contact if we don't have confirmation from AP by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Collections Analyst
Redwood Inference
